name: External Macro Data Feasibility Screen (v1.2.5)
source: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) via public CSV endpoint; Brooks (2017) macro-momentum framework extended with additional themes.
hypothesis: FRED provides sufficient macro-factor data for a 2014-2026 walk-forward with 504-day formation window. Additional FRED series beyond the E022/E023 5-theme set enable richer macro-momentum signal construction.

World_Bank.reason: Annual frequency only (65 obs, 1960-2025). Too low for monthly walk-forward requiring 504-day formation window.

BLS_API.reason: Limited history (~120 months back to 2019) without API key registration. Insufficient for 2014-2026 backtest.

BEA_API.reason: Requires API key for data access.

ECB_SDMX.reason: DNS resolution failure / service unavailable in this environment.

walk_forward_feasibility.conclusion: SUFFICIENT - all 5 core series cover the required formation period with 150+ monthly observations each through 2026-09

data_integrity_assessment.revision_risk: HIGH - FRED provides revised data, not real-time vintages. ALFRED (archival) requires API key.
data_integrity_assessment.mitigation_in_macro_py: release_lag_months=1 (conservative 1-month lag on monthly data). At month M, signal uses data through month M-1.
data_integrity_assessment.bias_direction: Revision look-ahead tends to OVERESTIMATE signal quality (documented in E022/E023).
data_integrity_assessment.v1_2_5_compliance: The data source is free, public, no roll-stitching artifacts (unlike yfinance =F futures), but revision risk must be explicitly disclosed in any experiment pre-registration.

pre_registered_pipeline_status.src_macro_py: EXISTS - implements Brooks (2017) 5-theme directional macro momentum with release-lag emulation, block-permutation placebo, z-scored signals, month-end rebalance weights
pre_registered_pipeline_status.e022_e023_validation: REPRODUCIBLE - E022 and E023 experiments used this pipeline and produced verifiable results
pre_registered_pipeline_status.extension_potential: HIGH - additional 14 FRED series can be integrated as new themes (e.g., labor market, yield curve, financial conditions, commodity prices)

decision: USABLE - FRED is the sole viable external macro data source. A v1.2.5-compliant macro-factor experiment can be pre-registered and executed using the existing src/macro.py infrastructure extended with additional themes. The revision-vintage caveat must be recorded in the experiment pre-registration.
recommended_next_experiment: E039: Extended Macro-Momentum with Additional FRED Themes (labor, yield curve, financial conditions, commodities) - pre-register gates, FE1/FE2, convention-robustness column (c2c + overnight per v1.2.3), block-permutation placebo.
